title: Comparative environmental claim without verifiable baseline

source.document: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Greenwashing, 2024

explain.en: Comparative claims require an explicit, verifiable baseline and substantiated methodology.

remediation.en: State the comparison baseline (year/product) and publish the comparative test report.

tests.notes: No baseline year or product specified

tests.input: Contains 30% less plastic than before (compared to 2022 baseline, audit report #2024-PL)
